data.description:
## Problem
The agentic plan-review engine (ADR 0123) signs a PASS for a run that read no code. `plan_review/agentic_verdict.py::adapt_findings` sets `coverage.llm_ran = True` and builds the verdict from the findings list alone. Nothing in `agentic.py`, `agentic_verdict.py` or the `agentic_review` step of `llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` checks how many tool calls the agent made. So an agent that answers `{"findings": []}` at once, with 0 `read_file`/`list_directory`/`search_files` calls, gets a non-blocking PASS and a certified plan-review attestation that the claim gate accepts.

The pipeline engine has no equivalent hole: every routed criterion chunk must return, and missing coverage resolves INDETERMINATE.

This is a silent-approval path in a gate.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An agentic run that made 0 tool calls resolves INDETERMINATE through the existing `resolution_class` path and mints no attestation, pinned by a test that counts attestations written.
- [ ] The agentic verdict's coverage records the tool-call count.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Agentic plan review signs a PASS with zero tool calls
